UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Strictly avoid AI slop, default Vercel white card layouts, or centered generic templates.
Ensure dark obsidian aesthetic with pure white high-impact text and signal red accents (#FF2A2A).
Every interactive element MUST have hover/focus transitions and a role-based data-testid attribute.
Pac-Man intro loading screen MUST be functional, entertaining, and include a clear working Skip button.
All modals, form fields, and copy-email buttons must work with instant UI feedback via Sonner toast notifications.
Containers with borders must have internal padding (p-6 or p-8) to prevent text collision.
